India's Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal calls for raising India-Italy bilateral trade to €50 billion, saying the existing target is not ambitious enough. Speaking in Rome, Goyal highlights opportunities in manufacturing, technology, semiconductors and clean energy, while expressing confidence that the India-EU Free Trade Agreement will unlock greater trade and investment between the two economies.
